mediaWork.title: Aggravating Circumstances
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Investigative podcast examining cases of alleged wrongful conviction, hidden evidence, and unintended consequences in the criminal justice system.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Multi-season independent investigative podcast hosted by Laura Szeremi. Season 1 examines the conviction of Destry Cord McKinney; Season 2 examines a disputed Florida self-defense case; Season 3 investigates the conviction of Tommy Hall.
